entities.name: NAPE-PLD candidate
observations: 416-aa query matches reviewed rat, bovine, and human NAPE-hydrolyzing phospholipase D homologs at 70.1–72.3% identity and 83.4–85.3% query coverage.
Homolog annotations identify EC 3.1.4.54 and binding of two Zn2+ ions per subunit.

entities.name: NAPE hydrolysis RHEA:33159
observations: Curated homolog reaction: N-acyl-1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphoethanolamine + H2O → N-acylethanolamine + 1,2-diacyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphate + H+.
